description: Kernel-mystery probe (T-1778 round 3, erfc-probes): where exactly does ERF/ERFC switch from the small-x erf rational to the erfc kernel e, and is 0.5 itself on the small side? Below the switch ERFC(x) = 1 - ERF(x) exactly; above it ERF(x) = fl(1 - e) and ERFC(-x) = fl(2 - e), so ERFC != 1-ERF at about half the points just above the switch. Consecutive doubles: rows 1-512 are the 512 doubles below 0.5, row 513 is 0.5, rows 514-1024 the doubles above. A = x, B = ERF.PRECISE(x), C = ERFC.PRECISE(x), D = ERFC.PRECISE(-x). Runs: run=0 split05: rows 1-512 below 0.5, row 513 = 0.5 x0=0x1.ffffffffffe00p-2 n=1024 row=1
